Tournament - Mechanics' Institute

# 2026 Fall Tuesday Night Marathon

Welcome to our new website! If you notice anything missing or in need of an update, feel free to let us know at chessroom@milibrary.org. We appreciate your feedback!

Top games are broadcasted on Chess.com with a 15-min delay: https://www.chess.com/events/2026-fall-tuesday-night-marathon

Pre-TNM lecture schedule:

9/1 GM in Residence Sam Shankland

9/8 GM Mark Heimann

9/15 IM Elliott Winslow

9/22 IM Elliott Winslow

9/29 IM Elliott Winslow

10/6 IM Ladia Jirasek

10/13 IM John Donaldson The Game of the Century: 70 Years Later

## Info

- Date: Tue, Sep 1 - Tue, Oct 13, 2026 
- Eligibility: Open to Everyone! 
- Rating: USCF & FIDE 

- Location: Mechanics' Institute, 4th Floor, 57 Post Street, San Francisco, CA 94104
- Capacity: 120 

## Registration

- Online Registration Open Until: Tuesday, October 13: 6:30 pm
- Entry fee for Mechanics' Institute Members: $70 

- Play-up fee: $15
- Entry fee for Non-Members: $100 

- Play-up fee: $20
- Late fee: $10
- $5 admin fee for all cancellations & refunds.

Two ways to check your entries:

- Check the live entries on the Jumbula site by clicking on the View Entries button.
- Check the processed entries here a day before the event.

## Tournament Format

- Tournament Format: Swiss System 
- Total Rounds: 7
- Time control: 90 min basetime + 30 sec increment 
- Round Times: 9/1 6:30pm 9/8 6:30pm 9/15 6:30pm 9/22 6:30pm 9/29 6:30pm 10/6 6:30pm 10/13 6:30pm 
- Sections: 2000+ 1600-1999 Under1600 

Play-up "200-rating point rule":

- Players must have an 1800 USCF regular supplemental or actual regular rating to be eligible to play up to the 2000+ section.
- Players must have a 1400 USCF regular supplemental or actual regular rating to be eligible to play up to the 1600-1999 section.

US Chess rating will be used for section determination and pairings. FIDE or other ratings are only used if no US Chess rating is available. 

Pairings are based on the Sep 202
